title: Can AI-generated 3D assets actually make it into a game? - Free Webinar
author: Pradyumgg
selftext:
Most AI 3D demos stop at a good-looking model. The difficult part comes after that: topology, retopo, textures, cleanup, and engine import.

We have been rebuilding that full pipeline with local models and will show it live on Tuesday, from concept to a usable game asset.

We will cover:

* where local models genuinely save time
* which steps still need manual work
* what breaks during cleanup and engine prep
* how the final asset moves into production

I am part of the Mixar team running the session.

[https://luma.com/v9wirdfw](https://luma.com/v9wirdfw)

For people already using AI for 3D, which part of the pipeline is causing the most trouble?
